primary_object_card.object_statement: A finite 30-plus-tick nested composition in which the layer-0 packet and layers 1-2 carrier plus Hopf flux drive two distinct Weyl engines, each executes its eight selected terrain stages as four signed operator microsteps, and the joint state then passes a live Schur nesting check, an entropy-capacity drive coupling, and a two-timescale occluded-object belief readout with controls and alternate math variants retained as non-promoting evidence.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: The ledger defines the distinct layer obligations, their carriers, tests, and claim ceilings.
The single-tick runtime supplies explicit packets, Hopf/Pancharatnam flux, GKSL evolution, live Schur elimination, cut readouts, and runnable controls.
The full QIT sim supplies the two eight-stage Weyl traversal orders and QuTiP engine-step semantics.
The source defines a view-local rho_fast plus an episode-persistent m_slow register, physicality checks, and leak controls.
The stage tournament fixes the four candidate operator-pair family and its K1/K2/K3 constraints.

primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: One shared state advances through the same order every tick: packet capacity and flux, two Weyl sheets, selected stage operators divided into signed microsteps, a joint Schur cut, and perception of a hidden bit in a small world generated from that state. The simulation does not claim that the adapter is nature or that good prediction proves a manifold. It records whether removing one microstep, flattening the nesting, scrambling stages, freezing senses, or removing the capacity drive changes the measured object.

native_terms.layer chain: The ordered per-tick data path whose layer output is passed to the next layer as state, never merely reported as an unrelated scalar.
native_terms.signed operator microstep: One quarter of a selected stage action with the sheet and field sign retained, so eight macro stages make thirty-two executed microsteps per Weyl engine.
native_terms.drop-one ablation: A same-tick counterfactual composition with exactly one of the sixty-four pair microsteps omitted and a state or readout delta recorded.
native_terms.capacity drive: The Hartley or entropy-gradient packet growth increment that multiplicatively changes quantum dissipation or phase rather than being a side readout.
native_terms.belief register: A rho_fast density per view and normalized m_slow posterior across views of one manifold-generated object, reset at the next object boundary.
native_terms.flattened control: The identical state path with the Schur nesting operator erased so L_eff can be compared against a non-nested evolution.

weirdness_signature: Two engines have opposite Weyl sheet signs and distinct traversal directions while sharing one joint quantum carrier.
Each selected macro stage is expanded into four signed microsteps, and every individual pair microstep has a live removal counterfactual.
The capacity drive must affect the quantum update itself and be falsified by its removal, rather than correlated post hoc with entropy.
The perception world is driven by the manifold state but its hidden target must never enter rho_fast or m_slow updates.
GF(8) and alternate flux-chart runs are alternate math families whose deltas are evidence, not winner declarations.

primary_object_card.adapter_policy: The GF(8) and alternate-chart lanes are adapters or variants only. Each must retain the root layer-chain and controls, name what it changes, and cannot replace the baseline source-composed object or become a promotion claim.
promotion_locks: classification is scratch_unified_v1 rather than canonical evidence
all referee checks are finite spot checks and cannot admit the full composition
alternate variants are recorded rather than judged

loop_contract.repair_rule: Repair the first source-lock, control, or receipt-schema failure before adding a wider variant or stronger claim.
loop_contract.stop_condition: All runnable controls and receipt invariants are recorded, or the first blocked source/API prerequisite is named without substituting a proxy.

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question is not authorization, but this explicit build directive authorizes only the named unified source, fresh receipts, and allowed runs.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: The execution order is checked separately from content: packet, flux, engines, microsteps, nesting, drive, and senses must appear in that order for each tick.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: During debugging preserve the source baseline objects and only repair the new composition layer, receipt, or declared adapter path.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: Target: live nested composition with a load-bearing drive; falsifier: a control fails to change its measured object; decisive check classifies each result killed, open, or survived.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: Operation: execute and remove declared layers or microsteps; observable: state, flux, entropy, belief, and correlation deltas; pass/fail: the frozen thresholds and receipt checks decide the result.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: The synthesis refuses to merge a scratch finite run, variant delta, or referee spot check into canonical, official, or scientific advancement.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve source, runtime, and control questions with local checks before asking; ask only if a real owner choice or unrecoverable dependency remains.
